# Minnie Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Minnie Andrews is a model pupil who is widely regarded as lacking any spark of imagination or life. Characterized as dull and poky, she never seems to have a good time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Minnie Andrews is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. She is among the students who warmly welcome [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upon her return to the classroom following a period of absence. Beyond being part of the welcoming group of peers at school, Minnie remains a background figure in the local village.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P1](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P4](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XVII.
